raw.description:
MariaDB is making a big impact on the world. Whether you’re checking your bank account, buying a coffee, shopping online, making a phone call, listening to music, taking out a loan or ordering takeout – MariaDB is the backbone of applications used everyday. Companies small and large, including 75% of the Fortune 500, run MariaDB, touching the lives of billions of people. With massive reach through Linux distributions, enterprise deployments and public clouds, MariaDB is uniquely positioned as the leading database for modern application development.

The Opportunity

You'll be responsible for driving strategic outbound pipeline development, identifying high-value opportunities, and initiating contact with potential enterprise customers through sophisticated, multi-channel outbound campaigns. Rather than conducting traditional cold outreach from absolute zero, you will tap into a massive community of "open-source curious" prospects and active community users, leveraging their familiarity with MariaDB to initiate enterprise-grade conversations.

Throughout your conversations, you will map complex corporate structures, multi-thread across strategic accounts, detect deep customer pain points, and help these organizations understand how MariaDB’s enterprise solutions can solve their mission-critical data challenges. As part of our Product Advisors team, you will play a critical role in our growth by executing a rigorous outbound prospecting motion that directly builds pipeline and supports our Enterprise Sales team. MariaDB has a consistent track record of promoting from within, and we are looking for candidates who are excited about advancing their sales careers by revolutionizing the way data is stored and accessed.

What You'll Do:

  • Strategic Account Mapping: Identify high-potential enterprise businesses and map complex corporate structures to identify key decision-makers who fit the MariaDB ideal customer profile.
  • Enterprise Multi-Threading: Develop and execute rigorous territory plans using advanced outbound prospecting methodologies (phone, email, and social) to multi-thread across both technical and business stakeholders within strategic accounts.
  • Community-Led Outbound Motion: Leverage open-source community interest, product downloads, and digital footprints to turn existing brand warmth into qualified enterprise sales cycles.
  • Campaign Development & Alignment: Partner closely with the Marketing and Enterprise Sales teams to design, execute, and lead account-based outbound campaigns from initial strategy through to qualified transition.
  • Complex Discovery: Schedule and facilitate high-level sales discovery calls, ensuring a seamless, deeply qualified handoff of prospects to Enterprise Sales Account Executives.
  • Navigate Enterprise Orgs: Confidently interact with, engage, and influence senior IT leadership, architecture teams, and business decision-makers.
  • Nurture & Build: Actively nurture early-phase enterprise opportunities, guiding community users toward the value of enterprise-grade support, scale, performance, and security.
  • Data Hygiene: Meticulously update, track, and manage all lead and prospect activity in Salesforce and Salesloft to ensure flawless pipeline visibility.
  • Exceed Targets: Consistently hit and exceed monthly and quarterly outbound opportunity quotas.

What You'll Need:

  • Experience: 2–4 years of dedicated B2B Business Development or outbound prospecting experience, with a proven focus on mapping and targeting enterprise accounts.
  • Education: BA/BS degree.
  • Communication: Outstanding active listening, communication, and storytelling skills, with the ability to hold peer-level conversations with technical executives and developers.
  • Drive: A self-starter mentality with a demonstrable track record of hitting and exceeding pipeline generation goals.
  • Strategic Thinking: Sharp time management skills and the ability to operate independently within a structured outbound motion, while remaining highly coachable.
  • Adaptability: Desire to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth enterprise tech environment.
  • Tech Savvy: Passionate about cutting-edge database technology, with a high aptitude for quickly learning complex IT software products and business-critical solutions.

Location: Remote - Bucharest, Romania

What’s in It for You?

Impact the world of technology by pushing the boundaries of technology and business models, working at MariaDB. Be part of a game-changing organization that encourages outside-the-box thinking, values empowerment, and is truly shaping the future of the software industry. You’ll be collaborating with high-caliber colleagues around the world, offering unparalleled learning and growth opportunities. We provide a very competitive compensation package, additional benefits and a massive degree of flexibility, freedom, and more.

How to Apply

  • If you are interested in this position, please submit your application along with your resume/CV through our ATS Greenhouse.
  • MariaDB does not sponsor work visas or relocation.
  • MariaDB is committed to providing accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
  • MariaDB will not accept agency resumes without a prior contractual agreement with HR. Please do not forward resumes to any recruiting alias or employee directly. MariaDB is not responsible for any unsolicited resumes.
  • MariaDB is an equal opportunities employer

About Seekeasy

Seekeasy helps restaurants and hospitality businesses unlock revenue growth with creator-led demand intelligence. We turn social media signals into actionable insights on trends, customer demand, and marketing opportunities and help brands activate on these insights with creator marketing campaigns through Seekeasy’s managed creator marketplace. As a funded seed-stage startup and a veteran team, we're on a mission to leverage AI to deliver the tools to bring creators and restaurants together to ensure restaurants are actively part of the social media conversation.

What You'll Do

Build our AI intelligence platform: Design, implement, and continuously improve AI-powered workflows that transform structured and unstructured data into actionable business intelligence. Build systems that enable AI to perform increasingly sophisticated analytical work while maintaining quality and reliability.

Build our analytics infrastructure: Develop scalable data pipelines, dashboards, reporting systems, and analytical models that power product decisions, customer insights, restaurant intelligence, and strategic partnerships.

Turn data into competitive advantage: Analyze millions of AI-generated restaurant attributes and social media signals to identify emerging consumer trends, marketplace opportunities, product insights, and business recommendations that influence company strategy.

Shape how we use AI: Develop and refine AI workflows, prompt engineering strategies, evaluation frameworks, and automation systems that continuously increase the speed, quality, and scale of analytical work across the company.

Ensure our intelligence platform is working: Continuously improve the quality, accuracy, and reliability of our data and AI outputs. Monitor data quality, identify anomalies, troubleshoot issues, and optimize systems for scalability and performance.

Lead and mentor: Help establish best practices for AI-assisted analysis, automation, and data-driven decision making. Set the standards for the team of people and AIs we will eventually have.

Who You Are

You are an AI multiplier: You don't simply use AI. You instinctively think about how to teach AI to perform the work you do so you can continuously increase your impact. You automate first and repeat yourself as little as possible.

You are a builder: You love to build, ship, get feedback, and iterate because that's the only way to know what's working and what isn't.

You are an owner: You take pride in your work and can operate autonomously to drive your work forward. Seekeasy is not the right fit for people who default to waiting for instructions.

You are a team player: You see yourself as part of the team, not just as someone working on the same project. Whatever it takes for the team to succeed, you want to be a part of it.

You are insight obsessed: You love finding patterns hidden inside messy data and turning them into decisions that create meaningful business impact.

Your Qualifications

  • Proficient with Python, SQL, AWS services, Git, relational databases, and modern data platforms.

  • Proficient with AI platforms, APIs, and frameworks including large language models, prompt engineering, retrieval augmented generation (RAG), vector search, AI agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP), LangGraph, LangChain, or similar technologies.

  • Experience building scalable data pipelines, analytical models, dashboards, and reporting systems using modern data engineering and analytics best practices.

  • Experience working with search technologies such as Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, or similar search and indexing platforms.

  • Passionate about AI and its potential to transform how businesses operate. You don't just use AI to be more productive. You think about how to train AI to become a trusted analytical teammate that scales your expertise.

  • Strong analytical and statistical problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations.

  • A problem solver who thrives in the ambiguity and fast pace of startup environments.

  • A seasoned AI, data, or analytics professional with 6+ years of experience in Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, Business Intelligence, or a related technical discipline, with a track record of building scalable analytical systems.

  • Live in the San Francisco Bay Area and can commute to our office in San Francisco.

  • Previous startup experience.

Compensation and Benefits

  • $150,000 - 200,000/year

  • Generous equity grant – be a true owner in the company you're building.

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance - we cover 100% for employees and 80% for dependents.

  • Flexible vacation policy – we trust you to manage your time and bring your best.

Seekeasy is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other legally-protected status. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process - please contact jobs@seekeasy.ai to request an accommodation.

Seekeasy will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law.

Company Overview

Hourly, Inc. is a fast-growing fintech and insurtech pioneer that simplifies payroll and workers’ compensation for small and mid-sized businesses (SMBs) across the United States. While traditional payroll and insurance systems rely on manual data entry and outdated processes, Hourly leverages a proprietary, real-time technology ecosystem to bridge the gap between labor costs and insurance premiums.

By integrating time tracking, payroll, and workers’ comp into a single, intuitive platform, Hourly enables business owners to run payroll in under 30 seconds and eliminates the stress of year-end workers’ comp audits. Hourly is transforming how the 80+ million hourly workers in America are paid and protected.

Position Background

Since its launch, Hourly has seen rapid adoption, particularly in high-complexity sectors such as construction, hospitality, and service industries. As we move into 2026, Hourly is expanding its footprint to meet the increasing demand for transparent, mobile-first financial tools that support both employers and employees.

The Territory Sales Manager will be a critical driver of this expansion. This is a "hunter" role designed for high-performing sales professionals who thrive in a high-activity, short-cycle environment. You will be responsible for generating new business by selling Hourly’s integrated solution directly to SMB owners and building a robust referral network of CPAs, insurance brokers, and financial advisors. This role offers a unique opportunity to build a personal book of business with uncapped commission potential and long-term residual income

Corporate Structure

This position reports directly to the Regional Sales Director.

This is a 100% remote role that requires proactive territory management. While you own your pipeline, you are supported by a dedicated Sales Enablement team, Customer Success managers, and modern CRM tools to ensure seamless onboarding and high client retention.

Key Responsibilities

Pipeline & Territory Management

  • Lead Generation: Drive consistent outbound activity to generate a 3–4x pipeline coverage through cold outreach, referrals, and local events.
  • Full Sales Cycle Ownership: Manage the entire process from initial discovery and platform demos to proposal development and closing the first payroll run.
  • Sales Targets: Consistently close 8+ new accounts per month to meet and exceed territorial production objectives.

Partner Relationship Development

  • Referral Networks: Identify and cultivate strategic partnerships with CPAs, insurance brokers, and banks to create a steady stream of warm leads.
  • Market Engagement: Actively participate in local industry trade associations and events to build the Hourly brand within your territory.

Strategic Operations

  • Data Integrity: Maintain meticulous CRM hygiene and provide accurate weekly forecasting to leadership.
  • Customer Success Collaboration: Work closely with the onboarding team to ensure a "white-glove" transition for new clients, focusing on 85%+ retention for integrated accounts.
  • Competitive Analysis: Gather field intelligence on local competitors and market trends to inform Hourly’s go-to-market strategy.

Requirements

  • Experience: 1+ years of B2B field or territory sales experience, specifically within payroll, HCM, workers’ comp, or the insurance industry.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field (preferred).
  • Skills: * Proven "hunter" mentality with a track record of exceeding new-logo quotas.
    • Strong closing skills and the ability to navigate short, high-volume sales cycles.
    • Excellent verbal and written communication, with a knack for presenting complex fintech solutions simply.
    • Proficient with Google Workspace and modern CRM tools (Salesforce etc.).
  • Attributes: Self-starter with superior organizational skills; comfortable selling to SMB owners in blue-collar and service-based industries.

Benefits

  • Base Salary: $60,000
  • First-Year OTE: $120,000 (Base + Commission + Residuals)
  • Uncapped Upside: No commission ceilings; higher performance unlocks higher tiers.
  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance.
  • Future Planning: 401(k) retirement plan.
  • Flexibility: Unlimited Time Off (PTO) and 100% remote work environment.
  • Support: Communication stipend, client entertainment budget, and mileage/expense reimbursement.

Hello! We're Teya.

Teya is a payment and software service provider, headquartered in London serving small, local businesses across Europe. Founded in 2019, we build easy to use, integrated tools that enable our members to accept payments and boost business performance.

At Teya we believe small, local businesses are the lifeblood of our communities.

We’re here because we don’t believe there’s a level playing field that gives small businesses with a fighting chance against the giants of the high street.

We’re here because we see banks and legacy service providers making things harder for them. We don’t think the best technology or the best service should be reserved for those with the biggest headquarters.

We’re here to fight for a future where small, local businesses can thrive, and to commit the same dedication they offer all of us.

Become a part of our story.

We’re looking for exceptional talent to join our mission. We offer a chance to create impact in a high-energy and connected culture, while benefiting from continuous learning opportunities, a supportive community which is proud to serve our mission, and comprehensive benefits.

As we continue to expand our operations in the UK, we're looking for an Area Sales Manager to help scale our established Independent Sales Consultant (ISC) channel across the North of England.

This is a fast-paced, high-velocity field role working alongside self-employed sales professionals who operate as independent partners. Reporting into a Regional Sales Manager (RSM) and supported by the wider channel team, you'll build a high-performing, sustainable regional operation taking responsibility for coaching and developing your ISCs from their very first week through to the point they're ready to operate independently.

This is a hands-on, field-based role with real autonomy. Success is measured by both the revenue impact you drive and the strength and maturity of the channel you help build.

Day-to-day you’ll be responsible for:

  • Build, lead and inspire a commission-only sales network, setting the standard, driving accountability, and earning influence without relying on traditional management levers.

  • Take full ownership of your team's commercial performance, turning a self-employed consultant in their first week into a high-output revenue engine.

  • Be there for every step of the ISC journey with a particular focus on their first 90 days, showing up in person, building trust, laying the foundations of the partnership and making every stage of the Teya journey count.

  • Get out in the field alongside your ISCs, coaching live on merchant calls, running weekly reviews, and doing whatever it takes to keep your team sharp and on track.

  • Stay ahead of the curve by running regular quality assessments with Sales Enablement and RSMs, identifying blockers, pricing issues and at-risk ISCs before they become problems.

  • Unite new joiners and experienced sellers across your territory through monthly in-person sessions that forge a genuine team culture and fuel consistent performance.

  • Dig into the data to uncover growth opportunities, cut through friction, and keep your region accelerating.

  • Champion the consultant experience at every level, taking field insight directly to Product, Marketing and Operations to make Teya's tools, messaging and resources the best they can be.

Your Story

  • Proven track record in B2B field sales, ideally within payments, fintech or software.

  • Commercially literate and comfortable with performance data, incentive structures and the unit economics that drive a healthy channel.

  • Highly organised and resilient, able to manage multiple priorities and keep standards high in a fast-moving environment.

  • A direct, empathetic communicator who can give honest feedback and hold people accountable without losing the relationship.

  • Process disciplined and familiar with structured framework and what it takes to build something that scales.

  • Car owner/driver with willingness to spend a minimum of 50% of your time in the field across your region.

The Perks

  • We trust you, so we offer flexible working hours, as long as it suits both you and your team.

  • Physical and mental health support through our partnership with GymPass, giving free access to over 1,500 gyms in the UK, 1-1 therapy, meditation sessions, digital fitness and nutrition apps.

  • Our company offers extended and improved maternity and paternity leave choices, giving employees more flexibility and support.

  • Cycle-to-Work Scheme.

  • Health and Life Insurance.

  • Enhanced Pension Scheme.

  • 25 days of Annual Leave.

raw.description:
The salary range for this role is $50,000 - $120,000 per year (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Sr. AI engineer who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

You will be responsible for overseeing the design, development, and deployment of machine learning models that power and enhance our financial platform. In this role, you will drive the creation of scalable machine learning solutions for personalized recommendations in the Sezzle marketplace, fraud detection, and credit risk assessment, utilizing a combination of cloud services, open-source tools, and proprietary algorithms.

Your leadership will be key in blending machine learning development and operations (MLOps) to automate and optimize the full lifecycle of our ML models. You will collaborate with a team of engineers and data scientists to build large-scale, high-quality solutions that address diverse challenges in the shopping and fintech space. You’ll ensure our AI-driven features are robust, efficient, and scalable as we continue to grow.

What You'll Do:

  • Design, Build, and Maintain Scalable ML Infrastructure: Lead the design and development of scalable machine learning infrastructure on AWS, utilizing services like AWS Sagemaker for efficient model training and deployment.
  • Collaborate with Product Teams: Work closely with product teams to develop MVPs for AI-driven features, ensuring quick iterations and market testing to refine solutions effectively.
  • Develop Monitoring & Alerting Frameworks: Create and enhance monitoring and alerting systems for machine learning models to ensure high performance, reliability, and minimal downtime.
  • Support Cross-Departmental AI Utilization: Enable various departments within the organization to leverage AI/ML models, including cutting-edge Generative AI solutions, for different use cases.
  • Provide Production Support: Offer expertise in debugging and resolving issues related to machine learning models in production, participating in on-call rotations for operational troubleshooting and incident resolution.
  • Scale ML Architecture: Design and scale machine learning architecture to support rapid user growth, leveraging deep knowledge of AWS and ML best practices to ensure robustness and efficiency.
  • Mentor and Elevate Team Skills: Conduct code reviews, mentor team members, and elevate overall team capabilities through knowledge sharing and collaboration.
  • Stay Ahead of the Curve: Stay updated with the latest advancements in machine learning technologies and AWS services, driving the adoption of cutting-edge solutions to maintain a competitive edge.

What We Look For:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Machine Learning, Statistics, Physics, or a relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
  • At least 6+ years of experience in machine learning engineering, with demonstrated success in deploying scalable ML models in a production environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Deep expertise in one or more of the following areas: machine learning, recommendation systems, pattern recognition, data mining, artificial intelligence, or related technical fields.
  • Proven track record of developing machine learning models from inception to business impact, demonstrating the ability to solve complex challenges with innovative solutions.
  • Proficiency with Python is required, and experience with Golang is a plus.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership in guiding teams, owning end-to-end projects, and setting the technical direction to achieve project goals efficiently.
  • Experience working with relational databases, data warehouses, and using SQL to explore them.
  • Strong familiarity with AWS cloud services, especially in deploying and managing machine learning solutions and scaling them in a cost-effective manner.
  • Knowledgeable in Kubernetes, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines for efficient deployment and management of ML models.
  • Comfortable with monitoring and observability tools tailored for machine learning models (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, AWS CloudWatch) and experienced in developing recommender systems or enhancing user experiences through personalized recommendations.
  • Solid foundation in data processing and pipeline frameworks (e.g., Apache Spark, Kafka) for handling real-time data streams.

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Thailand. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Thailand.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

You’ll lead the development and scaling of our Native Advertising capabilities across Taboola, Microsoft Ads, LiveIntent, and Newsbreak, working alongside Creative, CRO, and Analytics teams to build a high-performing media buying organization.

This isn’t a role for someone who simply wants to manage campaigns.

It’s an opportunity to build a platform.

You’ll initially lead a team of three Media Buyers while helping us recruit and develop additional specialists. As the business grows, you’ll play a key role in shaping the future of our Native Advertising organization, with a clear opportunity to grow into Head of Native Pod.

If you’re passionate about experimentation, building teams, and solving difficult performance marketing challenges at scale, we’d love to talk.

﻿Key Responsibilities:

Lead the Native Advertising Function

  • Own the overall performance and strategic direction of our Native Advertising channels, including Taboola, Microsoft Ads Native, LiveIntent, and Newsbreak.
  • Develop platform-specific strategies that support sustainable client growth while maintaining profitability and operational efficiency.
  • Continuously identify new opportunities to improve campaign performance, testing velocity, and scalability.

Build and Develop a High-Performing Team

  • Lead, mentor, and support an initial team of three Media Buyers.
  • Recruit and onboard additional Media Buyers as the team expands.
  • Create an environment focused on accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and high performance.
  • Provide regular coaching, campaign reviews, and performance feedback to help team members grow professionally.

Drive Performance Excellence

  • Ensure campaigns are executed and optimized according to clearly defined performance standards.
  • Monitor key business metrics, including lead volume and quality, cost efficiency, and profitability.
  • Support Media Buyers in identifying scaling opportunities, troubleshooting performance issues, and making data-driven optimization decisions.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of platform updates, industry trends, and competitive activity.

Own Testing Strategy

  • Develop structured testing frameworks across targeting, bidding, placements, creatives, and campaign optimization.
  • Promote a culture of experimentation where decisions are driven by data rather than assumptions.
  • Ensure testing results are documented, shared, and incorporated into operational best practices.

Collaborate Across Functions

  • Partner closely with Design, CRO, Analytics, and Operations teams to improve campaign quality and execution speed.
  • Translate business objectives into clear testing priorities and cross-functional initiatives.
  • Help improve workflows that enable faster experimentation and more efficient campaign launches.

Build Scalable Systems

  • Establish platform standards, documentation, playbooks, and operational processes that enable consistent execution across the team.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks and implement solutions that improve quality, efficiency, and scalability.
  • Contribute to the long-term development of our performance marketing organization by continuously improving how the team operates.

Requirements

Required

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in Performance Marketing or Media Buying.
  • Previous experience managing, mentoring, or leading Media Buyers.
  • Experience with one or more Native Advertising platforms, including Taboola, Outbrain, Microsoft Ads, LiveIntent, Newsbreak, MGID, or MediaGo.
  • Experience managing campaigns targeting North American markets.
  • Strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach to decision making.
  • Proven experience optimizing campaigns at scale.
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills.
  • Fluent English.

Preferred

  • Experience in lead generation and performance marketing.
  • Experience working in agency or high-growth performance marketing environments.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered marketing tools and workflow automation.

Job Title: Strategic Partnerships Manager

Location | Remote

Time Zone | Global (Travel required for in-person networking and industry events)

Role Overview:

We are seeking a Strategic Partnerships Manager to manage platform relationships, source ad account capacity, resolve compliance issues, and unlock access that standard agency channels cannot provide within a performance-driven digital advertising environment. This is not a coordination role — success depends entirely on the depth of existing relationships inside Meta and the ability to convert those relationships into fast, measurable outcomes. The ideal candidate comes in with contacts already in place, knows how to activate them immediately, and continues building from there.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Leverage existing Meta relationships — in account management, compliance, partner management, or advertising — to source ad accounts, unblock flagged accounts, and resolve policy issues on behalf of advertisers

  • Actively network with Meta employees in person at conferences, industry events, and platform meetups to build and deepen relationships with people who can drive outcomes

  • Advocate for the business and its advertiser clients to secure faster approvals, higher spending limits, and access to beta programs or dedicated account management

  • Work directly with advertisers in sensitive verticals — nutraceuticals, casino, finance, sweepstakes, and similar — to understand compliance challenges and bring those problems to platform contacts with viable solutions

  • Maintain platform relationships on a personal and professional level — ongoing engagement, not just transactional outreach when something breaks

  • Deliver quick wins early, with the first 30 to 60 days producing tangible results in ad account availability or issue resolution

  • Track and report on relationship health, platform access outcomes, and revenue impact from partnership activity

  • Travel to relevant industry events globally as needed — physical presence at key events is non-negotiable

Required Qualifications:

  • Specific, named contacts within Meta — in account management, compliance, or partner-facing roles (this is the single most important requirement and will be assessed directly in the interview process)

  • Demonstrated experience working with or alongside Meta in a capacity beyond media buying — account management, compliance navigation, partner programs, or platform relationships (hands-on ad buying experience is not required)

  • Comfort working with advertisers in sensitive verticals such as nutraceuticals, casino, finance, and sweepstakes, including an understanding of the compliance challenges these advertisers face and strategies for navigating them

  • A proven track record of converting relationships into tangible business outcomes quickly — not just knowing people, but activating them when it counts

  • Strong in-person networking instincts — someone who shows up, follows through, and builds relationships that last beyond a conference badge scan

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

  • Self-directed and able to deliver measurable results within the first 60 to 90 days

  • Must have prior remote work experience and be fluent with remote collaboration tools and platforms (such as Slack, Zoom, Google Workspace, or similar). Applications without this experience will not be considered.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in the affiliate marketing space, particularly with performance-driven advertisers in regulated or sensitive categories

  • Contacts at Google, TikTok, or other major ad platforms in addition to Meta

  • Active involvement in affiliate or performance marketing industry communities and events

  • Existing relationships with ad account brokers, resellers, or agency network partners

Tools & Technology:

  • Meta Business Suite / Meta Ads Manager

  • CRM or relationship-tracking tools

  • Google Workspace

  • Slack, Zoom, and other remote collaboration tools

Please NOTE:

It is crucial that you complete the application form in full. As part of the application process, you will be required to record a video. If your application is successful, you will receive an email confirming next steps—the video is the first step of the interview process. If you do not record a video, we will not be able to consider you for ANY open roles.

We connect top talent with vetted employers, competitive pay, and real growth opportunities.

OUR COMPANY

HCEsquared® is a leading healthcare solutions platform developed by healthcare specialists for healthcare specialists to elevate patient care. We serve our community of clinicians by delivering practical clinical and non-clinical content through digital and in-person connections​. We provide our clinicians with solutions to serve their patients through onsite and digital educational content based on the newest and best therapies and techniques from respected thought leaders in the field of dermatology as well as services to enhance their career trajectories. Our offerings have been proven to enhance clinician confidence, demonstrated by our exceptional audience and partner retention rates for our ecosystem. For more details on our clinician offerings and continuing medical education, please visit our portfolio companies on the hcesquared.com website. Our conferences can be viewed at www.dermsquared.org

WHY JOIN HCESQUARED®?

At HCEsquared®, our mission is simple: elevate patient outcomes by elevating the people who deliver care. When you join us, you become part of a team that blends healthcare expertise, educational excellence, and a shared commitment to making a measurable impact.

Meaningful WorkYour contributions directly strengthen the skills and performance of healthcare professionals. Your work ultimately improves patient lives.

Growth-Driven CultureWe develop our people through coaching, stretch assignments, and opportunities to lead. Your professional growth isn’t a perk, it’s a priority.

Values-Led TeamworkYou’ll collaborate with high-performing colleagues who care about integrity and continuous improvement.

Empowered InnovationWe encourage new ideas and give you the autonomy to innovate and improve processes.

Flexibility With AccountabilityRemote work creates the flexibility you need while maintaining the high expectations forperformance, communication, and ownership.

THE ESSENTIALS

This role is best suited for individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment and bring a proven track record of delivering results through strong partnership and influence.

  • Vision – the ability to zoom out, define what “good” looks like, and clearly communicate that direction across and beyond the organization.
  • Strategic problem solving – the ability to translate vision into action by breaking complex opportunities or challenges into simple, executable strategies.
  • Grounded Leadership – the ability to lead with confidence in direction while demonstrating humility in execution, taking ownership, seeking input, and adapting as new information emerges.
  • Accountability and collaboration – the ability to take ownership of outcomes while motivating others to work effectively across the organization and setting clear expectations.
  • Grit – the willingness and ability to overcome challenges, move beyond ideas, and consistently drive results.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Title: Senior Director, Event Production
Reporting To: VP, Production
Location: Remote (U.S.) - Eastern or Central Time Zones strongly preferred
Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. HCEsquared® does not sponsor or assume sponsorship of employment visas

ROLE SUMMARY

As Senior Director, Event Production, you own the seamless, end-to-end execution of our in-person conferences and specialized workshops—turning complex logistics into experiences that feel effortless to everyone in the room. Reporting into the VP, Production, this role serves as the leader of the events execution team of meeting planners and event managers, you set the standard for how dermatology professionals come together: every detail considered, every moment intentional, every event one they remember. When healthcare professionals attend an HCEsquared event, they don't just show up to a conference—they step into a polished, immersive experience that keeps them coming back.

ACCOUNTABILITY

  • Delivery of the conference portfolio within approved timelines, budgets, and execution standards
  • Events execution team recruited, developed, and led to deliver consistent performance across the portfolio
  • Execution insights and constraints communicated proactively to inform portfolio planning and optimization
  • Exhibit core leadership competencies including accountability, collaboration, strategic vision, problem-solving, resilience, and humility

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Recruit, develop, and lead the events execution team (meeting planners and event managers) to deliver consistent, high-quality conference and workshop experiences across the portfolio
  • Own day-to-day operational leadership for conference logistics, including F&B, room blocks, exhibit execution, and workshop delivery

raw.description:
Noë & Associates is a global brand consultancy working across real estate, hospitality, and luxury. We specialise in the unbuilt — creating brands and telling the stories of places before they exist. From our studios in New York, London, and Dubai, we have helped bring billions of dollars of developments to market for clients including Aman, Rosewood, Mandarin Oriental, Jumeirah, and IHG.
We are hiring an AI Cinematographer to help us picture the unbuilt: cinematic film and motion, made with the new generation of generative video tools, for some of the world’s most ambitious luxury developments and destinations.
We are proud to be part of Together Group, a curated collective of high-quality creative consultancies, marketing, technology and production studios. Together, we create and elevate brands, experiences and destinations of the future.

This role is initially offered on a contract basis, with the potential to become permanent.

Key Responsibilities

The role

This is a craft role at the frontier. You trained in film and you think like a cinematographer — in composition, lens, light, movement, and pace — and you have carried that language into AI video, where the tools now let us show a place, a feeling, and a way of living long before anything is built.
You will work alongside our strategists, designers, editors, and producers to develop the look and feel of residences, resorts, and destinations still in design — turning a vision into something a client and their audience can actually see and feel.

What you’ll do

• Create cinematic film and motion with generative video tools — from early concept films to finished campaign work.
• Work primarily in Kling, our current tool of choice, with room to use Seedance and other tools where they serve the work better.
• Translate real cinematographic craft — framing, lensing, lighting, camera movement, edit rhythm — into prompts, references, and generative workflows that hold a high bar for taste and finish.
• Develop looks and visual worlds for the unbuilt: places that do not yet exist, made convincing and beautiful on screen.
• Exercise judgement about tools — which model or approach serves a given shot, and when a result is genuinely good enough to ship.
• Stay at the edge of a fast-moving field and bring back what is worth using.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

• A real grounding in film. Film school or equivalent training, with genuine command of cinematic language, pacing, and storytelling — film specifically, not photography. You think in motion, and you know how a single shot lives within a sequence.
• Fluency with AI video generation. Hands-on experience with Kling especially; Seedance and/or other generative tools are valued, along with the judgement to know which suits the shot.
• An eye for the high end. Taste, precision, and restraint suited to luxury brands — with a feel for architecture and the spaces our work brings to life.
• Self-direction. Clear communication and the discipline to own work across time zones.

We are open on level. The role suits a recent film graduate fluent in today’s tools, but we are glad to talk to stronger candidates.

Head of Club Deal – Immobilier Premium (Indépendant / Associé minoritaire)

Nous lançons une activité de club deals immobiliers premium, structurée autour d’un cercle restreint d’investisseurs avertis et qualifiés, dans un cadre strictement privé.

Objectif du modèle
Structurer et opérer des investissements immobiliers haut de gamme (immeubles de rapport, hospitality, opérations de rénovation premium) via des véhicules dédiés, sur des opérations sélectionnées off-market.

⚠️ Cette activité ne constitue pas une offre au public de titres financiers. Aucun conseil en investissement réglementé n’est délivré.

Vos missions

Rôle

En tant que Head of Club Deal, vous pilotez l’activité dès son lancement :

  • Sourcing d’opportunités off-market
    Identification d’actifs immobiliers premium présentant un fort potentiel économique (objectifs de performance non garantis).
  • Structuration des opérations
    Coordination des montages juridiques et fiscaux (SAS, SCI, LMNP, pactes d’associés) avec les conseils externes.
  • Coordination investisseurs
    Animation de la relation avec un cercle d’investisseurs qualifiés (HNWI), organisation des échanges et du process de souscription privé.
  • Due diligence & négociation
    Supervision des audits techniques, financiers et juridiques. Pilotage des négociations.
  • Suivi & reporting
    Mise en place d’un reporting périodique clair et transparent.
  • Déploiement du modèle
    Lancement de la première opération cible en 2026 et structuration du modèle opérationnel.

Vos compétences

Profil recherché

  • 5 ans minimum en club deals, private equity immobilier ou structuration d’opérations immobilières
  • Track record démontrable sur des opérations privées
  • Solide compréhension des structures juridiques et fiscales immobilières
  • Réseau actif d’investisseurs avertis / professionnels
  • Autonomie complète sur le deal flow

Avantages

  • Statut : Indépendant / Associé minoritaire (pas de CDI)
  • Rémunération : Commissions sur opérations réalisées / Participation au capital et/ou aux résultats futurs des véhicules

Ce poste s’adresse à un dealmaker confirmé souhaitant prendre une position stratégique dans un projet à fort potentiel. Vous ne rejoignez pas une structure établie : vous co-construisez l’activité dès son lancement, avec une participation au capital.

Dans le cadre de ses fonctions, ce poste n’implique pas :
– De conseil en investissement réglementé,
– De démarchage financier,

– De recommandation personnalisée.

Les investisseurs sont des professionnels ou assimilés, intervenant dans un cadre strictement privé.

Statut : Indépendant / associé minoritaire (pas de CDI)
Rémunération : 100 % variable (commissions) + equity

Profil idéal
Professionnel aguerri avec un track record démontrable, un réseau actif d’investisseurs qualifiés et la capacité à structurer et closer des opérations complexes en autonomie complète.

Ce que nous offrons
Une opportunité rare de bâtir une activité de club deals immobiliers premium dès le lancement, avec une rémunération variable attractive et une participation significative au capital.

Prochaine étape
Envoyez votre dossier complet (CV, track record, pitch de deal) avant le 31 janvier 2026.
Les entretiens auront lieu en février. Un maximum de 5 candidats sera retenu pour la phase finale.

Démarrage du projet : 15 mars 2026.

raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for mobile developers to build BJAK's AI Neobank app across Android and iOS.

This role is for strong mobile builders who can ship clean, reliable and intuitive mobile experiences, whether their main strength is Android, iOS or both.

What Will You Build

  • Build mobile features across Android, iOS or cross-platform flows depending on your strength.

  • Create clean journeys for onboarding, accounts, payments, cards, transfers, rewards, travel, FX and AI-assisted features.

  • Work from product problem to shipped mobile experience, not just assigned screens.

  • Collaborate with backend, design, product and AI teams to launch reliable customer-facing features.

  • Improve app quality through production feedback, analytics, crash reports and user behaviour.

  • Help raise the standard for mobile UX, reliability and speed across the product.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong mobile development experience in Android, iOS or both.

  • Experience shipping production mobile apps used by real users.

  • Good product sense, UX judgement and attention to edge cases.

  • Able to work across APIs, releases, debugging and production issues.

  • Hands-on builder who can take ownership without heavy guidance.

  • Clear evidence of shipped work: app links, GitHub, screenshots or project explanations.

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Indonesia. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Indonesia.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Technical Product Manager

raw.title: Technical Product Manager
raw.excerpt: Seer Interactive is a digital marketing consultancy that harnesses compassion, data, technology, and AI to make a mark on our communities—our coworkers, our clients, our industry, and our neighbors.
raw.description:
Seer Interactive is a digital marketing consultancy that harnesses compassion, data, technology, and AI to make a mark on our communities—our coworkers, our clients, our industry, and our neighbors. We relentlessly pursue (and share) the truth, bringing together millions of data points from quantitative and qualitative sources, enhanced by responsible, human-centered AI. Our purpose is to unlock potential across these communities, envisioning a world where doing the right thing is intuitive and informed.
At Seer, we see AI as a catalyst for innovation, collaboration, and creativity. Regardless of your division or discipline, leveraging AI is a core part of how we deliver smarter, faster, and more strategic outcomes for our clients. Our AI Council drives company-wide integration by focusing on education, purposeful implementation, and continuous learning — ensuring that AI is embedded in how we think, operate, and grow.
If you’re ready to uplift others, challenge your ego, commit to the truth, and be better than yesterday—keep reading.
Seer is a remote-first agency and a Certified B-Corp, with team members across the country. If an office environment is more your style, this position can also sit in our HQ office in Philadelphia. We can only consider candidates based in the US who can work continental US-based hours.

The Role:

You've spent your career at the intersection of data and delivery, translating messy pipelines into clean products and vague requirements into shipped features. At Seer's AI & Innovation division, we need exactly that. You'll own the data product portfolio: BigQuery Connectors, Looker dashboards, and AI Agents, taking full responsibility for the sprint cycle from backlog to release. This isn't a strategy-and-delegate role. You'll be writing specs, testing features, and unblocking engineers the same week you're running sprint planning and managing the PMs who report to you.

Role Highlights

    Product Ownership

  • Own end-to-end product management for BigQuery Connectors, Looker dashboards, and AI Agents, from requirements through QA, documentation, and ongoing health monitoring
  • Define product specs and acceptance criteria in partnership with division leaders and SMEs
  • Monitor product health, usage metrics, and production incidents; address issues with urgency
  • Make recommendations on what to productize, sunset, maintain, or optimize

    • Sprint Planning & Engineering Coordination

  • Own the sprint planning process end-to-end, in partnership with a Project Manager
  • Oversee data engineer hours and priorities across sprint cycles
  • Own backlog prioritization, capacity planning, and sprint completion accountability
  • Balance competing priorities across new development, maintenance, and custom client work

    • Productization Execution

  • Execute the productization of validated R&D innovations in partnership with the Director of Engineering & Product
  • Enable Engineering to transform prototypes into production-ready products
  • Create maintenance plans and support models; partner with the Innovation team on handoff requirements

    • Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Own cross-functional relationships with R&D, division leads, Marketing, and AI Strategy
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for data product questions and timelines
  • Translate technical constraints and capacity realities into clear stakeholder communication

    • Data Governance & Platform Administration

  • Manage data access and permissions across Looker and data platforms
  • Own platform integrations, system administration, and compliance with data security and client confidentiality requirements
  • Maintain monitoring dashboards for system health and usage

    • Team Management

  • Manage Product Managers and conduct performance reviews and career development conversations
  • Build clear roles, responsibilities, and success criteria as the team scales
  • Develop product management capability in direct reports

You'll be a good fit if....

  • You have hands-on product management experience, including writing specs, testing features, and maintaining documentation, not just overseeing others who do it
  • You have worked with data-intensive products and are comfortable discussing pipelines, APIs, and architecture with engineers
  • You have experience running agile sprint planning, owning backlogs, managing capacity, and hitting committed sprint goals
  • You are able to balance competing priorities across multiple product lines without losing velocity or quality
  • You are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information in a fast-moving environment
  • You are a clear communicator who can translate technical realities into plain language for non-technical stakeholders
  • You have experience managing or mentoring team members and care about building people up as much as building products
  • You have experience using AI tools to accelerate research, analysis, or product work and are always looking for leverage

    • Bonus points if:

  • You have familiarity with BigQuery, Looker, or similar data platforms as a product owner
  • You have shipped AI agent products or agentic workflows in a production environment
  • You have experience defining production-ready standards or productization playbooks from scratch
  • You have an agency or consulting background where client needs and product roadmap work had to coexist

This might not be the role for you if...

  • You prefer to set strategy and hand off execution, as this role requires you to do the work alongside managing others
  • You're looking for full creative latitude on greenfield products, as this role is about productizing validated innovations and maintaining a portfolio in motion
  • You need detailed requirements handed to you before you can act, as a lot of this role involves defining what "done" looks like for things that don't have a clear spec yet
  • Managing multiple product lines with different stakeholders, cadences, and quality bars at the same time sounds exhausting rather than energizing
  • Data infrastructure isn't something you find genuinely interesting, as you'll be deep in pipelines, connectors, and platform health every week

30/60/90

    First 30 Days - Learn

  • Get fully oriented in Seer's data product portfolio: the current state of BigQuery Connectors, Looker dashboards, and AI Agents, and what's in the pipeline
  • Shadow sprint ceremonies and meet with division leads, R&D, and data engineers to understand cross-functional dependencies
  • Identify one backlog item you can personally own and deliver to calibrate on the sprint process

    • 60 Days - Build

  • Own sprint planning end-to-end with a completion rate teams can rely on
  • Produce your first product spec or requirements document from scratch and get it to engineering-ready
  • Take over cross-functional communication so stakeholders have a reliable point of contact for data product timelines

    • 90 Days - Lead

  • Running the sprint cycle independently with clear capacity plans, prioritized backlogs, and predictable delivery
  • Executing at least one R&D-to-production handoff with a maintenance plan in place
  • Contributing to the roadmap conversation with a clear point of view on what to productize, maintain, or sunset
Ready to apply? Ditch the cover letter — we don’t need it. We’d rather see your AI chops. Use ourMarketing Career AI Self-Assessment GPT to find out where you land on the AI marketing maturity curve and share your results with us. Our team is excited to read your application responses and will be using them to help determine who we’d like to meet with!
Have questions about recruitment at Seer? Check out ourCustom GPT: Guide to Talent Acquisition at Seerto drop in your questions! You can ask it anything about our hiring process, and how to best prepare for an interview with us.
As a B-Corp Certified organization, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.
Not ready to apply but want to keep in touch? Stay connected via our monthly Career Update newsletter! We'll share curated content on Seer, open roles, industry insights, career advice, events you don't want to miss, and more (so you never miss a beat).

raw.title: Application Architect
raw.excerpt: Langate is an award-winning provider of web development services in 3 main categories: business, healthcare, and education.
raw.description:
Langate is an award-winning provider of web development services in 3 main categories: business, healthcare, and education. At Langate, we're passionate about crafting digital solutions that make a real impact. We take immense pride in our strong collaboration with the U.S. We're here to shape the future of technology, one milestone at a time.

In addition to technical expertise, we value excellent communication skills. Collaboration and effective teamwork are the cornerstones of our success, and we believe in fostering an environment where everyone’s voice is heard and valued.

This role is for a hands-on Application Architect who wants genuine ownership - driving key architectural decisions and directly influencing how a modern US e-commerce platform is built and evolves. You'll lead three parallel workstreams (legacy ColdFusion -> Angular/.NET migration, on-prem -> Azure re-platforming, and a greenfield Order Management System) and you'll do it in a team that treats AI-augmented engineering as a first-class skill. If you live in Claude Code and ChatGPT, co-author PRDs with BAs, and can turn a spec into a working prototype in a couple of days, this is the seat for you.

About the project: 

Leading national online destination for durable medical equipment (DME), As part of its ongoing commitment to customer experience, performance, and scalability, is modernizing its custom-built e-commerce platform by migrating from Adobe ColdFusion to a modern Angular frontend with a .NET Core backend.

Requirements:

  • 10+ years of hands-on engineering experience with .NET / C# (.NET 8+), of which 3+ in an Architect or Lead role on production e-commerce or large-scale transactional systems

  • Clean Architecture and CQRS (MediatR, Dapper, Hangfire, Polly)

  • Strong practical command of Clean Architecture/Vertical Slice, CQRS, and integration patterns (MediatR, Dapper, Hangfire/Quartz, Polly, MassTransit / Service Bus)

  • Solid experience with Angular (latest LTS) - able to guide frontend architecture, review code, and pair with the UI team on storefront migration

  • Proven Azure architecture experience: App Service / Container Apps, Azure SQL, Service Bus, Key Vault, Application Insights, Azure DevOps CI/CD; IaC with Bicep or Terraform

  • Hands-on experience designing and delivering Order Management/e-commerce backends (catalog, pricing, cart, checkout, payments, fulfillment, returns)

  • Mandatory: practical Agentic / AI-Augmented Engineering experience - daily use of Claude Code, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot or equivalent for code generation, refactoring, code review, and rapid prototyping; familiarity with spec-driven / PRD-driven AI workflows (e.g., BMAD-METHOD, Spec-Kit, or similar)

  • Ability to co-author PRDs with Business Analysts, decompose them into technical specs / ADRs, and produce a working prototype within days using AI coding agents

  • Experience modernizing legacy platforms (ColdFusion, classic ASP.NET, or similar monolith → modern stack) and migrating workloads from on-prem to Azure is a strong plus

  • Strong written and verbal English (Upper-Intermediate / Advanced) - must communicate confidently with US-based product, engineering, and non-technical stakeholders

  • Comfort working as the technical face of the engagement: leading discovery sessions, presenting trade-offs to the client, and making and defending architectural decisions

  • Comfort working with distributed teams and collaborating with US-based clients

Responsibilities:

  • Migration of the legacy ColdFusion e-commerce platform to a modern Angular storefront served with a .NET 8+ backend

  • Lift-and-shift / re-platforming of the existing system from on-prem to Azure (target architecture, landing zone, IaC, CI/CD, cutover plan)

  • Greenfield design and delivery of a new Order Management System (OMS) and future engagement projects to onboard franchise and corporate stores

  • Use AI coding agents (Claude Code, ChatGPT, Copilot) to rapidly prototype concepts, validate integration approaches, and accelerate the team's delivery velocity

  • Define and enforce engineering standards: branching strategy, code review, testing pyramid, observability, security/PCI-DSS posture

  • Hands-on contribution: write production code on critical paths (auth, checkout, OMS core), unblock the team, lead spikes

  • Lead technical discovery and refinement sessions with the client; present architectural options and trade-offs to both engineering and business stakeholders

  • Mentor the .NET and Angular engineers; raise the bar on AI-augmented development practices across the team

Team:

From our side: 1 PM, 1 BA, 3devs

From the client side: 1 .Net full-stack dev, 3 ColdFusion devs, BA

TechStack:

  • Legacy: Adobe ColdFusion, SQL Server (on-prem)

  • Target: .NET 8 (C#), Angular (latest LTS), Azure SQL / SQL MI, Azure App Service / Container Apps, Azure Service Bus, Azure DevOps

  • Data access: EF Core + Dapper hybrid

  • Observability: Application Insights, Elastic APM, Bugsnag

  • AI tooling expected in daily workflow: Claude / Claude Code, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot

   

Schedule: 5/2, 8-hour working day (40 hr per week), flexible schedule. Ability to interact with New York time zone at least 4 hours a day

Hiring process: HR interview + Technical Interview

Why Choose Us? What Do We Offer that's Exceptional?

  1. Cutting-Edge Technologies on Real Projects: At Langate, you'll work with the latest technologies on live projects. We're a dynamic, fast-growing company, so you'll find a minimal amount of legacy systems and plenty of opportunities to implement new technologies.

  1. Work-Life Balance with Benefits: We value work-life balance and offer paid time off, including vacation days and sick leave. Remote work options and hearty life are part of the package, too.

  1. Investment in Your Growth: We're committed to your professional development. You can expect training programs, courses, and opportunities to enhance your English language skills.

  1. Team Building and Unity: We know that a happy team is a productive team. That's why we organize team-building events and group activities to foster strong bonds and a sense of belonging.

When you choose us, you're choosing a company that values innovation, invests in its employees, and provides a supportive and engaging work environment. Join us in shaping the future of technology!

  

Need more information? Welcome!

raw.description:
Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well-being, and work-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.

Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.

The Senior Producer, Brand Storytelling is responsible for developing and producing compelling editorial content that brings Empower’s brand, products, leaders, employees, and customer stories to life. This role combines journalism, creative storytelling, and multimedia production to create authentic, engaging narratives that deepen audience trust, strengthen brand affinity, and support strategic business priorities. Working cross-functionally with Brand, Communications, Product Marketing, Social, Creative, and executive stakeholders, the Senior Producer leads content development from concepts through final delivery across video, audio, written, and digital formats. This role applies strong editorial judgment, storytelling expertise, and production leadership to create content that is credible, human-centered, and aligned with Empower’s brand standards.

What you will do:

  • Identify, research, and develop compelling stories across Empower’s products, customers, employees, leadership, and brand initiatives.
  • Translate complex financial wellness, wealth, and retirement topics into clear, engaging, audience-focused narratives.
  • Create and pitch editorial concepts for video series, podcasts, executive storytelling initiatives, customer features, and branded content programs.
  • Lead end-to-end production of multimedia content from concept development through final publication.
  • Conduct research, interviews, story development, scriptwriting, editorial planning, and content review activities.
  • Coordinate production schedules, talent preparation, shoot logistics, recording sessions, and post-production workflows.
  • Collaborate with creative internal teams and external production partners to ensure high-quality content execution.
  • Oversee editing workflows, review cycles, factchecking, stakeholder approvals, and final content delivery.
  • Produce recurring video and podcast content featuring executives, customers, industry experts, and subject matter experts.
  • Prepare hosts, executives, and on-camera talent through interview preparation, scripting support, and storytelling guidance.
  • Shape narratives with strong editorial judgment, pacing, tone, and audience relevance across long-form and short-form formats.
  • Develop platform-specific content adaptations and promotional assets for social and digital channels.
  • Apply journalistic principles to uncover authentic insights, strengthen storytelling quality, and maintain content credibility.
  • Ensure all content meets established editorial, legal, compliance, brand, and quality standards.
  • Monitor emerging storytelling trends, audience behaviors, podcast formats, creator-led media, and content distribution best practices.
  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to align content strategies with organizational objectives and audience needs.
  • Support the development, execution, and growth of recurring content franchises, executive-led storytelling series, and thought leadership programming.
  • Contribute as an individual contributor without formal people leadership responsibilities.

What you will bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree required in Journalism, Communications, Media Production, Marketing, English, Film, Broadcasting, or a related field.
  • 5–10+ years of experience in brand storytelling, editorial content, journalism, podcasting, video production, documentary-style content creation, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience producing video and/or podcast content from concept development through post-production.
  • Strong writing and storytelling skills, including script development, editorial planning, narrative structure, and interview content creation.
  • Proven ability to interview executives, customers, subject matter experts, and other stakeholders.
  • Strong editorial judgment with the ability to develop content that is engaging, credible, and strategically aligned.
  • Ability to simplify complex topics into accessible and audience-relevant content.
  • Experience managing multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills across creative, marketing, communications, legal, and executive teams.
  • Experience with content production and editing tools such as Adobe Premiere, Descript, Riverside, Final Cut Pro, or similar platforms.
  • Familiarity with social-first storytelling principles and multi-platform content distribution strategies.
  • Ability and willingness to appear on camera when business needs require.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and project management skills.
  • Background in journalism, documentary filmmaking, editorial media, branded content, or related storytelling disciplines.
  • Experience producing content within financial services, fintech, healthcare, or other regulated industries is preferred.
  • Experience launching, scaling, or managing recurring content franchises or executive-led content series is preferred.

Work Environment & Disclaimer

This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications of the job. The employer has the right to revise this job description at any time. You will be evaluated in part based on your performance of the responsibilities and/or tasks listed in this job description. You may be required to perform other duties that are not included in this job description. The job description is not a contract for employment, and either you or the employer may terminate employment at any time, for any reason, as per terms and conditions of your employment contract.

GTM Engineer

Full-time · Remote (Latin America) · US Pacific-hours overlap ·

About the role

We're hiring a GTM Engineer to treat growth as an engineering problem: design and operationalize the systems behind demand capture, lead routing, and experimentation. The marketing operation exists and runs today — the job is to transform its workflows with automation and AI, and build the production-grade systems it runs on next. This is a fast-iteration role: build something, ship it, watch real numbers move, and iterate.

What you'll do

  • Identify and prioritize the highest-leverage GTM motion to transform first, partnering with the marketing team to surface opportunities and develop the strategy to act on them

  • Build and ship working automations with Claude Code and event-driven tools like Zapier and n8n, taking prototypes to production and productizing tools for team-wide use

  • Own the enrichment strategy — ICP segmentation and scoring, and signal-to-action workflows that turn raw data into sales-ready intelligence for reps

  • Design and run multi-channel prospecting pipelines: built-in A/B testing, automated enrichment and scoring, response-detection routing, backed by deliverability infrastructure (SPF/DKIM/DMARC, domain warmup, bounce handling)

  • Support ABM and paid media — audience targeting on LinkedIn and Google, suppression and match-rate workflows, connecting ad-platform engagement to pipeline data, and testing/bidding automation

  • Use AI to scale organic and inbound demand, improving how the brand surfaces in search and AI-generated answers, and tightening capture, routing, and speed-to-lead

What we're looking for

  • Professional experience in GTM engineering, revenue technology, data engineering, or a closely related technical domain

  • Strong bias toward action — you'd rather ship a working prototype and iterate than spec something to death

  • Hands-on experience with workflow automation platforms (Zapier, n8n, Clay, or similar), with real shipped automations, not configured templates

  • Salesforce familiarity, including the data model and experience integrating with or automating within the CRM

  • Experience connecting systems via APIs — REST, webhooks, OAuth, rate limiting, error handling

  • An owner mindset — not just closing tickets, but asking whether the right problems are being solved the right way

  • Deep understanding of sales, marketing, and revenue processes

  • Active engagement with the AI space, with workflows already built using LLMs like Claude, GPT, or Gemini

  • Strong written and spoken English, and willingness to work US Pacific-overlap hours

Nice to have

Snowflake or other data warehouses (Databricks, BigQuery), a software or data engineering background, Python or JavaScript scripting, or prior high-growth startup experience building foundational systems from scratch.

What you get

  • Monthly live training sessions with senior operators from US tech companies

  • A community of GTM engineers who review each other's builds and share what works

  • Real career growth as the network expands

At The Global Talent Co., our mission is to bridge the gap between leading global tech companies and amazing global talent. We believe everyone deserves equal access to opportunities, regardless of the country they are born in.
